pattern: ように見える（ようにみえる）
purpose: Describe an appearance without asserting that it is reality.
keywords: Plain form + ように見える; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ように見える
This rock looks like a human face.
He appears to be looking for something.
In the photograph, the room looks spacious.
formation: Plain form + ように見える; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ように見える
restrictions: Usually rests on visible appearance, though a broader impression is possible.
mistake: 元気に見える directly uses an adjective adverb; 元気なように見える uses the full pattern.
